exposure: umbilical blood flow index (normal vs. high)
cohort: The study recruited 119 pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) admitted to Yichang Central People's Hospital between January 2022 and January 2024.
finding: A significant correlation was observed between umbilical blood flow indices and various adverse maternal and fetal outcomes in pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus.
mod_finding: The high umbilical blood flow index group exhibited significantly higher rates of cesarean section compared to the normal umbilical blood flow index group.
